info.name: Huntress API Reference Accounts Summary Reports API

params.name: limit
params.description: Max number of resources returned in a paged collection. Defaults to 10, with a minimum of 1 and maximum 500.

params.name: page_token
params.description: Token used to request the next page in paginated results. Defaults to 'null'

params.name: sort_field
params.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to 'id'.

params.name: period_min
params.description: Filter by an ISO-8601 formatted date string that represents the lower bound of the search range for the period date.

params.name: period_max
params.description: Filter by an ISO-8601 formatted date string that represents the upper bound of the search range for the period date.

params.name: organization_id
params.description: Filter by organization ID within Huntress account

params.name: type
params.description: Filter by report type. One of monthly_summary, quarterly_summary, yearly_summary

items.docs:
Shows Summary Reports associated with your account.

**Note:** This endpoint will also return a `pagination` key on the root level.  
Please refer to the [pagination section](https://api.huntress.io/docs#pagination) within our docs for more information.
Shows details on a single Summary Report associated with your account.
